create table public.games (
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid(),
  week_id text,
  home_team_id text not null,
  away_team_id text not null,
  start_time timestamp with time zone not null,
  status text default 'SCHEDULED'::text,
  home_score integer,
  away_score integer,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  nhl_game_id integer
);

create table public.picks (
  id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid,
  week_id text,
  game_id uuid,
  selected_team_id text not null,
  confidence integer not null,
  points_earned integer default 0,
  result text default 'PENDING'::text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

create table public.profiles (
  id uuid not null,
  email text not null,
  name text not null,
  avatar text,
  role text default 'member'::text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

create table public.weeks (
  id text not null,
  week_number integer not null,
  saturday_date date not null,
  status text default 'OPEN'::text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);
alter table public.games add constraint games_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id);
alter table public.picks add constraint picks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id);
alter table public.profiles add constraint profiles_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id);
alter table public.weeks add constraint weeks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id);
alter table public.games add constraint games_week_home_away_unique UNIQUE (week_id, home_team_id, away_team_id);
alter table public.picks add constraint picks_user_id_week_id_confidence_key UNIQUE (user_id, week_id, confidence);
alter table public.picks add constraint picks_user_id_week_id_game_id_key UNIQUE (user_id, week_id, game_id);
alter table public.profiles add constraint profiles_email_key UNIQUE (email);
alter table public.games add constraint games_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['SCHEDULED'::text, 'LIVE'::text, 'FINAL'::text])));
alter table public.picks add constraint picks_confidence_check CHECK (((confidence >= 1) AND (confidence <= 5)));
alter table public.picks add constraint picks_result_check CHECK ((result = ANY (ARRAY['WIN'::text, 'LOSS'::text, 'PENDING'::text])));
alter table public.profiles add constraint profiles_role_check CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'member'::text])));
alter table public.weeks add constraint weeks_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['OPEN'::text, 'LOCKED'::text, 'COMPLETED'::text])));
alter table public.games add constraint games_week_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (week_id) REFERENCES weeks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
alter table public.picks add constraint picks_game_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (game_id) REFERENCES games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
alter table public.picks add constraint picks_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
alter table public.picks add constraint picks_week_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (week_id) REFERENCES weeks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
alter table public.profiles add constraint profiles_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
CREATE INDEX idx_games_week ON public.games USING btree (week_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_games_nhl_id ON public.games USING btree (nhl_game_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_picks_user_week ON public.picks USING btree (user_id, week_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_picks_game ON public.picks USING btree (game_id);
alter table public.games enable row level security;
alter table public.picks enable row level security;
alter table public.profiles enable row level security;
alter table public.weeks enable row level security;

create policy "Anyone can view games" on public.games as permissive for select to public
  using (true);

create policy games_insert_authenticated on public.games as permissive for insert to authenticated
  with check (is_member());

create policy "Users can delete own picks" on public.picks as permissive for delete to public
  using ((auth.uid() = user_id));

create policy "Users can insert own picks" on public.picks as permissive for insert to public
  with check ((auth.uid() = user_id));

create policy "Users can update own picks" on public.picks as permissive for update to public
  using ((auth.uid() = user_id));

create policy picks_select_own_or_revealed on public.picks as permissive for select to authenticated
  using (((auth.uid() = user_id) OR picks_revealed(week_id)));

create policy profiles_select_all on public.profiles as permissive for select to authenticated
  using (is_member());

create policy "Anyone can view weeks" on public.weeks as permissive for select to public
  using (true);

create policy weeks_insert_authenticated on public.weeks as permissive for insert to authenticated
  with check (is_member());

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_invite_code()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  select upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12));
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (select p.role = 'admin' from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid()),
    false
  );
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_member()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid());
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalise_invite_code(p_code text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql

AS $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.picks_revealed(p_week_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    ((w.saturday_date + time '10:00') at time zone 'America/New_York') <= now(),
    false
  )
  from public.weeks w
  where w.id = p_week_id;
$function$
;
